full_judgment:
12. This time Mrs. Taherunnessa went on appeal in Title Appeal No.131 of 1986. It was heard by Mr. Humayun Ali, Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka and the learned Additional District Judge in his lengthy judgment written in Bengali reversed the judgment and allowed the appeal by setting aside the judgment and the decree passed by the learned Munsif and directed that Dr. Suraiya Hossain be evicted from the suit premises. 

 16. In the instant case it appears that after Mrs. Taherunnessa, the landlady won the Title Suit on appeals she went for execution of the decree but the said execution was stayed by this court at the time of issuance of the Rule in Civil Revision No. 561 of 1987 on 10.6.87. Therefore, Dr. Suraiya Hossain is still in the premises and as she was previously allowed by this court to pay house rent provisionally before the House Rent Controller, she is paying the rent to the House Rent Controller at the rate of Tk. 2,000/- per month. As to this there is no dispute.
